disclaimer: Synthetic policy for shadow-mode evaluation only. Not a credit policy and not a lending decision system.

rules.name: approve_low_risk
rules.description: Approve in shadow mode only when confidence is at least 0.85, the model label is low_risk, deterministic checks pass, and required evidence is present.

rules.name: review_mid_confidence
rules.description: Send to human review when confidence is between 0.65 and 0.85.

rules.name: reject_high_risk
rules.description: Reject in shadow mode when the model label is high_risk and confidence is at least 0.85, subject to policy review.

rules.name: review_low_confidence_or_missing_evidence
rules.description: Send to human review when confidence is below 0.65 or required evidence is missing.
